# Which changed files make a pull request worth a Claude Security scan.
# Read by scripts/securityscan.go (see openspec/specs/security-scan-gate once archived).
#
# One glob per line. "**" crosses directories, "*" stays within one; a glob
# with no "/" matches the file name in any directory. A leading "!" names files
# that do NOT need a scan. For each changed file the LAST matching line wins,
# and a file that no line matches is scanned, so a new kind of file errs towards
# scanning. The pull request is scanned if any changed file needs it.
#
# Changing this file is itself a scan (.github/** is listed below).

# Directories that are documentation by default. They come BEFORE the
# sensitive rules, so a Go file or a CLAUDE.md inside one still matches a later
# rule and is scanned (`go test ./...` compiles a .go file anywhere in the tree,
# and Claude reads a CLAUDE.md in any directory it works in).
!openspec/**
!docs/**
!site/**
!README.md
!LICENSE

# Code that handles untrusted input or the network
*.go
web/src/**

# Build, release and the container image
Dockerfile
.dockerignore
.goreleaser.yaml
.github/**

# Dependencies and the files that feed the build
go.mod
go.sum
web/package.json
web/package-lock.json
web/vite.config.ts
mappings/**
notices/**

# Files that configure Claude, which a pull request could use to steer a scan
.claude/**
**/.claude/**
CLAUDE.md
.mcp.json
.claude.json

# Exceptions: these never need a scan on their own. They sit after the
# sensitive rules for files that are tests or test data, so those stay exempt.
!*_test.go
!testdata/**
!web/src/test/**
!web/src/**/*.test.ts
!web/src/**/*.test.tsx

# ...except the tests that pin the gate and the workflows themselves: weakening
# them weakens the gate, so a change to them is scanned.
security_scan_test.go
workflows_test.go
